name: Nonpyogenic thrombosis of intracranial venous system
description: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis (CVST), cerebral venous and sinus thrombosis or cerebral venous thrombosis (CVT), is the presence of a blood clot in the dural venous sinuses, the cerebral veins, or both. Symptoms may include severe headache, visual symptoms, any of the symptoms of stroke such as weakness of the face and limbs on one side of the body, and seizures, which occur in around 40% of patients.

red_flags.condition: [LLM DRAFT] Acute intracranial hypertension or cerebral edema resulting in papilledema, rapidly progressive focal neurological deficits, or depressed mental status secondary to extensive venous sinus occlusion.
[LLM DRAFT] Acute hemorrhagic venous infarction manifesting as sudden severe headache, focal seizures, or acute neurological deterioration.

questions.text: [LLM DRAFT] Have you experienced a sudden, unusually severe headache often described as the worst headache of your life?
questions.purpose: Screens for acute thunderclap headache characteristic of cerebral venous thrombosis

questions.text: [LLM DRAFT] Have you noticed new vision changes, such as double vision or blurred vision, along with your headache?
questions.purpose: Screens for increased intracranial pressure symptoms like papilledema

questions.text: [LLM DRAFT] Have you experienced any new weakness, numbness, or difficulty speaking?
questions.purpose: Screens for focal neurological deficits caused by venous stroke

differentials.distinguishing_feature: [LLM DRAFT] Presents with signs of portal hypertension and abdominal pain rather than isolated intracranial hypertension and neurological deficits.
[LLM DRAFT] Associated with generalized erythrocytosis, splenomegaly, and hyperviscosity symptoms instead of localized cerebral venous outflow obstruction.
[LLM DRAFT] Manifests primarily with cardiac dysfunction or systemic arterial embolization rather than localized cerebral venous sinus occlusion.

icd10_official_description: Nonpyogenic thrombosis of intracranial venous system
